title: Jailer 2 Drops First Single Promo as Rajinikanth Sequel Eyes Record-Breaking October Release
excerpt: The promo for 'Ala Bolelo,' composed by Anirudh Ravichander, teases the first single from Rajinikanth's highly anticipated sequel ahead of its October 15 Dussehra release.
body:
• The first single 'Ala Bolelo' from Jailer 2 releases on August 21, with a promo featuring Rajinikanth alongside actress Shamna Kasim (Poorna)
  • The sequel has already secured a reported Rs 160 crore OTT deal with Amazon Prime Video — the largest ever for a Tamil film
  • Jailer 2 releases theatrically on October 15, 2026, during the Dussehra weekend, with a massive ensemble cast including Mohanlal, Mithun Chakraborty, and Vidya Balan

The promotional machinery for Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 shifted into high gear this week with the release of a promo for the film's first single, 'Ala Bolelo.' The track, composed by Anirudh Ravichander with lyrics by Arunraja Kamaraj, is set to drop on August 21 and features vocals by Anirudh and Deepthi Suresh.

The promo draws comparisons to 'Kaavaalaa,' the Tamannaah Bhatia dance number from the 2023 original that became a viral sensation. This time, actress Shamna Kasim (known as Poorna) will be featured alongside the 75-year-old superstar in what is expected to be another mass-appeal dance sequence.

A Sequel Built on Blockbuster Foundations

The original Jailer, released in August 2023, grossed over Rs 600 crore worldwide and became the highest-grossing Tamil film of that year. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and produced by Kalanithi Maran's Sun Pictures, it cast Rajinikanth as "Tiger" Muthuvel Pandian, a retired jailer who uncovers a criminal network while searching for his missing son.

The sequel picks up that story with an even larger canvas. Principal photography began in March 2025 across locations in Chennai, Kerala, Mysore, and Goa, wrapping in April 2026. Reshoots were later scheduled for additional refinement.

Jailer 2 is set for a worldwide theatrical release on October 15, 2026, timed to the Dussehra holiday weekend — a strategic slot that has historically delivered massive openings for pan-India entertainers.

Star-Studded Ensemble

The cast is a who's who of Indian cinema. Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, and Mirnaa reprise their roles from the first film. New additions include Mithun Chakraborty, Vidya Balan (in her full-fledged Tamil debut), S. J. Suryah as the primary antagonist, and Suraj Venjaramoodu. Cameo appearances from Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar, Jackie Shroff, Hrithik Roshan, and Vijay Sethupathi round out an unprecedented lineup.

Sethupathi notably broke his own "no-cameo" policy for the role, citing personal admiration for Rajinikanth. Hrithik Roshan stepped in after Shah Rukh Khan reportedly declined a cameo to avoid having his look from the upcoming film King appear in another project first.

"I made a special exception to my no-cameo policy because of my personal admiration for Rajinikanth sir and the opportunity to learn from him."

— Vijay Sethupathi

Record-Breaking Pre-Release Business

Even before hitting theaters, Jailer 2 has made commercial history. Amazon Prime Video reportedly acquired the post-theatrical digital streaming rights for Rs 160 crore, according to Cinema Express and The Times of India — the highest OTT deal ever for a Tamil film. The previous record was Rs 150 crore for Kamal Haasan's Thug Life, while the original Jailer was acquired for Rs 75 crore in 2023.

Bollywood Hungama reported on August 18 that the deal establishes a new benchmark, with trade analysts noting that the pre-release business alone has already secured the film's financial standing.

What Diaspora Audiences Can Expect

For the millions of Tamil cinema fans across the US, UK, Canada, and the Gulf, Jailer 2 is shaping up to be the biggest Indian film event of the fall. The original was a major draw in overseas markets, and the sequel's Dussehra release positions it for packed opening-weekend screenings in diaspora strongholds.

With Anirudh's music already building anticipation — the composer's sixth collaboration with Rajinikanth — the 'Ala Bolelo' single could well be the next dance-floor anthem at garba nights and Dussehra celebrations worldwide.
